text: A CW complex is built by:
choices: taking a colimit of simplicial sets
inductively attaching cells Dⁿ along attaching maps from Sⁿ⁻¹
taking the geometric realisation of a simplicial set
applying the nerve construction to a groupoid
explanation: A CW complex starts with a discrete set of 0-cells and inductively attaches n-cells via maps from the boundary Sⁿ⁻¹. All spheres, surfaces, and RP^n are CW complexes.
